name: Refrain Love 2
source:
In April hero decided to move to Sakurazaki Town to enter  university there. He rents a room in Scarlet Hall apartments. These several months he will spend together with his university colleagues and other boarding house members. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-january-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
4月，主人公决定搬到樱咲町，在当地上大学。他租下朱红馆公寓的一间房，接下来几个月将与大学同学及其他寄宿居民共同度过。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-january-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
